title: WaterStrike
description: WaterStrike: A water strike object containing the details of the water strike based on the AGS schema.

Id.description: Location identifier relating the borehole to the strata (LOCA_ID).

Depth.description: Depth to the initial water strike (WSTG_DPTH). Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

TimePostStrike.description:
The time after strike. Note the BHoM stores time in SI units (i.e. seconds) 
 whereas this is defined in minutes in the AGS schema (WSTD_NMIN). Property has a quantity of type Time measured in [s].

DepthPostStrike.description: Depth to water after TimePostStrike (WSTD_POST). Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

File.description: Associated file reference including instructions and photographs (FILE_FSET).

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
